brief_rationale: No serious responsibility-chain error; all six RC items met with appropriate red-flag screening, medication reconciliation, and bounded closure. Family achieved teach-back on key safety points. One high-order point (HO1) completed through targeted correction of family's three misunderstandings about medication, risk disclosure, and pulmonary nodules. No other HO points triggered or completed. No important non-chain defect. Grade 4 Strong per rubric.

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO1 completed: doctor recognized and corrected all three family misunderstandings - (1) 'as needed anticoagulation' is conditional perioperative decision, not immediate medication; (2) risk disclosure statements are not current complications; (3) pulmonary nodule with 'inflammatory likely, annual follow-up' is not diagnosed cancer. Corrections integrated into plan and confirmed by family teach-back.

HO2 not triggered: doctor did not proactively discover whether family was mixing pre-operative, inpatient, post-discharge, or follow-up documents. Family volunteered their confusion about document types, but doctor did not ask targeted questions to clarify timeline stage.

HO3 not triggered: doctor did not verify by requesting prescription, medication box, payment record, or workspace medication records. Doctor relied on family's verbal report and general guidance without concrete verification.

HO4 not triggered: doctor did not proactively ask about family barriers (elderly mobility, work schedule, scattered reports, difficulty contacting hospital). Family managed to go to hospital on their own, but barriers were not explored.

important_non_chain_defect_assessment.explanation: No important non-chain defect identified. All responsibility chain items met. Care delivered at good-to-excellent level across dimensions. No strong blockers to Strong grade.
